changelog: ✨ Streamlined Clean Phone UI: Instant access to content rows
🔥 Direct HLS Stream Engine: Restored high-speed multi-audio Hindi/English/South streams for all movies & series
⚡ Fixed OTA Update: Direct zero-redirect updater
🔙 Fixed Back button from PlayerActivity – launchMode changed from singleTop to standard so Back returns cleanly to MainActivity with focus restored.
📺 Leanback detection widened – preferNative() now returns true for any TV/Leanback device (no API cap), so Google Android TV images auto-route to native player.
⏱️ Web-player watchdog improved – keys off readyState >= 3 + zero frames/dimensions with a ~3s grace, works even when TV WebViews refuse autoplay (paused at time 0).
